title: High-ceiling JSON component engineering
focus: Turn project component JS from implicit files into a discoverable, machine-validated registry shared by preview, export, CLI, and AI verification.
one_version_one_thing: Only component registry and validation contract. No new editor panel, no new visual components, no cloud export, no TTS generation.

from_previous_version.baseline: v0.16.0 made showreel export diagnosable with performance JSON and inspector map.
from_previous_version.new_bottleneck: JSON compositions can reference arbitrary component files, but there is no registry or static contract check before preview/export.

success_picture: A composition can be checked before rendering. The user sees whether every component exists and exports mount/update; AI can read one JSON report and know exactly which track/component is unsafe.

verify_points.desc: The project component registry lists available component JS files and the subset used by a composition.
A local CLI validates component IDs, files, required mount/update exports, import-free single-file ABI, track usage, and observed params.
A bad component is blocked with structured JSON errors instead of silently disappearing in preview or export.
The same validated component source still compiles into preview/export runtime source without changing the existing showreel output path.
